prompt:
Help me write a business plan using the following outline. Use information from this website https://www.quantastandard.com/
1. Title
2. Executive Summary
3. Out Values and Value proposition
4. Customer Segments
5. Methodology
6. Platform
7. Statistics
8. Market
9. Future predictions
10. How we help
11. What we need = $1M
12. How it will be used
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most closely follows the requested business-plan outline and stays aligned with a “Quantum Standard” quantum/computing positioning. Candidates 2 and 3 significantly diverge from the apparent brand/topic implied by “Quantastandard” and do not credibly use website-specific information (3 even admits it’s hypothetical). Candidate 4 is closer in naming, but the content is generic and still doesn’t demonstrate using information from the specified site, with several unsubstantiated market/stat claims.
